issues.title: Add tenant isolation and authentication before connecting real customer data
issues.body:
## Problem
The API is intentionally public and mock-only. Loading real CSV data would expose names and personalized recommendations without authorization.

## Scope
Introduce authenticated store membership, tenant-scoped data access, audit events without conversation text, and explicit separation of public demo fixtures from production data.

## Acceptance criteria
- Unauthenticated protected requests return 401.
- Cross-tenant list and customer lookups reveal no data or customer existence.
- Public demo routes cannot load production sources.
- Automated tests cover read access, revoked membership, and cross-tenant IDs.

## Dependencies
Required before any real-data pilot.

issues.title: Validate imported customer data and return actionable dataset errors
issues.body:
## Problem
CSV loaders trust bundled fixtures. Missing columns, duplicate customer IDs, invalid booleans, malformed dates, and negative amounts are not validated; some inputs silently overwrite records or cause server errors.

## Scope
Define import schemas and validate datasets before activating a snapshot. Keep the previous valid snapshot when an import fails.

## Acceptance criteria
- Reject duplicate IDs and orphan customer references.
- Reject invalid dates, channel values, boolean encodings, negative currency values, and non-positive purchase cycles.
- Return row and field diagnostics without raw personal information.
- Tests cover missing, empty, malformed, and valid files.

## Dependencies
Tenant isolation before enabling external uploads.

issues.title: Track independent carts with cart IDs and ordered event timestamps
issues.body:
## Problem
The current schema has customer IDs and calendar dates, but no cart IDs or timestamps. The engine conservatively treats a customer's latest completed event as closing the cart flow; this cannot distinguish multiple simultaneous carts. Same-day completion currently wins ties.

## Scope
Add cart_id, event timestamps with timezone, and completion/abandonment event types. Select the latest eligible uncompleted cart independently of other carts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Completing cart A never suppresses abandoned cart B.
- Completion cancels reminders for its own cart.
- Duplicate and out-of-order events yield deterministic results.
- Future and expired events remain excluded.
- Import compatibility and timezone boundary tests are included.

## Dependencies
Validated ingestion schemas.

issues.title: Derive frequency caps from a consent-aware delivery ledger
issues.body:
## Problem
messages_last_30d is a static mock aggregate. Recommendations do not send messages or reserve capacity; concurrent dispatchers could exceed limits once delivery is added.

## Scope
Add a delivery ledger, atomic frequency-cap checks, idempotency keys, unsubscribe handling, and a separately documented support-contact policy. Recheck consent immediately before sending.

## Acceptance criteria
- Four marketing sends in a rolling 30-day window block further promotions.
- Duplicate requests cannot send twice.
- Concurrent requests cannot exceed the cap.
- Opt-out or do-not-disturb changes invalidate pending marketing work.
- Failure/retry semantics and complaint follow-up policy have tests.
- All automated tests use fake channel adapters; no real messages are sent.

## Dependencies
Authentication, tenant isolation, and approved channel integrations.

issues.title: Add offer eligibility and margin guardrails to recommendations
issues.body:
## Problem
Message templates currently promise free shipping, cashback, installments, discounts, and early access without checking stock, margin, merchant capabilities, or provider eligibility. These are mock suggestions, not validated offers.

## Scope
Introduce merchant offer configuration, budget and margin constraints, expiry dates, and a neutral reminder fallback.

## Acceptance criteria
- Disabled or unavailable incentives are never promised in messages.
- BNPL requires provider eligibility, not just a high cart value.
- Cashback and shipping subsidies respect a configured margin floor.
- Expired offers are rejected and explanations identify the constraint.
- Synthetic scenarios cover each rejected and eligible offer.

## Dependencies
Validated product and merchant data; required before real dispatch.

issues.title: Add reproducible outcome evaluation with snapshot-aware metrics
issues.body:
## Problem
The as_of parameter changes signal evaluation dates, but customer aggregates remain a fixed snapshot. It is not historical replay, and no campaign outcomes exist to demonstrate retention or margin improvements.

## Scope
Persist versioned customer snapshots, decision rule versions, and synthetic delivery/conversion outcomes. Define a holdout evaluation plan before introducing learned ranking.

## Acceptance criteria
- Replaying a snapshot with its rule version is deterministic.
- Historical evaluation excludes future purchases, messages, and aggregate updates.
- Reports distinguish mock metrics from measured business results.
- Conversion, incremental margin, opt-out, and complaint rates have documented denominators.
- Dataset and endpoint tests verify no temporal leakage.

## Dependencies
Ordered event ingestion and delivery ledger.
